text:
maria-sales: Halcyon Health POC — they asked for a minimal evidence bundle to close risk review: SOC2 excerpts (control mapping), an ISO cert excerpt, a signed pen-test letter, high-level network diagram, and a short dataflow for embeddings. They'd like this by EOD Thu. Also asked: cost impact if they require 12mo audit log retention.

sam-eng: Do they want the full SOC2 report or just an overview + control matrix? We usually provide an auditor cover page + control mapping csv instead of full reports.

maria-sales: Quote from customer: "SOC2 overview + control mapping is fine, no raw report." They do explicitly want the pen-test attestation signed by a Redwood rep/vendor.

alex-security: We have a pen-test attestation template (redwood-penletter-v1). Legal needs to sign final copy; turnaround typically 3-5 business days if no redlines. For SOC2 excerpts we can share the control matrix and auditor cover page; redaction policy: we can't remove auditor statements but we can mask customer-specific sample data.

lena-ps: For the network diagram and embeddings dataflow I can produce a one-page high-level diagram + a one-paragraph description of where PHI/PII is excluded. Presigned upload default TTL is 24h; ops can approve longer (we usually do 7 days max with justification).

maria-sales: Customer also asks whether we can provide redacted logs for 30 days (sanitized) instead of raw logs — and whether that changes price.

sam-eng: We do PII scrubbing in logs by default for hosted customers, but producing audit-grade sanitized log exports is semi-manual. Rough ops/eng effort estimate: 4-8 hours to run exports + verification. I'd flag a one-time ops fee (~$500) and a retention surcharge for 12mo (needs pricing bin).

alex-security: Also need to confirm if they want KMS/HSM key attestation or just a statement that keys are customer-segregated in Dedicated. If it's attestation, that's extra compliance work. I'll loop in Legal for signature path on the pen-letter.

ops-bot: Created ticket OPS-1287: Presigned uploads >24h and audit export request. Owner: @lena-ps.

lena-ps: I'll own OPS-1287. Maria — can you share the CISO contact and confirm whether redacted logs are acceptable? With that I can bundle network diagram + dataflow + SOC2 excerpts. ETA: EOD Fri to assemble docs (Thu was tight).

maria-sales: Got it — will get CISO contact and confirm redaction acceptance. Pushing customer to accept Fri. I'll update by EOD tomorrow. Thanks all :thumbsup:
